summary: This comparison helps laundry buyers decide which tag family fits their wash conditions, textile behavior and attachment model before the first pilot starts.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
PPS - Compact hard-shell laundry use - Strong durability profile for many harsher wash conditions

faq.question: Should every laundry project test all three tag families?
faq.answer: No. Once wash profile, textile type and attachment style are clear, some projects can rule out at least one tag family before sampling.

faq.question: Is the most durable tag always the best choice?
faq.answer: Not always. A harder tag can be less suitable if garment feel, bend or attachment method is just as important as durability.
